answer: Bind each identity to one hardware secure enclave: registration needs an attestation from a device key that cannot be copied, and one key sponsors only one identity. A sybil farmer then needs a separate physical device for every puppet, so mass forgery climbs from cheap code to a real summit of purchase and handling costs per unit. Each attestation is a single ember of proof from one distinct device, and slow glacier-paced audits revoke keys whose behaviour clusters suspiciously. Limits: agents on shared servers without enclaves are excluded, and stolen keys can be abused until revocation.
